text:
Maya (AE): Heads up — Acme procurement pushed our PO workflow back. They say they need a clean DPA version + order form before they raise PO. cc @Jordan @Carlos :wave

Ben (SE): Thanks — any redlines from Acme yet?

Maya (AE): They sent a tracked PDF with a few DPA comments and an ask to include KMS/HSM language for key custody. Also requested SLA uptime metric in the order form (99.9 min), and an invoice flow for EU entity.

Jordan (Legal): Can you drop the PDF here? I can triage quick redlines. If KMS language is required we need to confirm supported integrations and add the KMS appendix.

Maya (AE): Uploaded to thread (private link): https://files.example/acme/dpa-redline.pdf

Ksenia (PS): For private deployments we can support customer-managed KMS via our HSM integration. Need to confirm region and whether they require BYOK.

Carlos (Finance): Quick note on invoicing: if Acme requires invoice to EU entity, we'll need their VAT and PO billing address. Net30 okay? also, will this be charged to Hosted or Dedicated SKU?

Maya (AE): They want Dedicated reserved capacity, 12 month commit. Ballpark pricing already agreed: $45,000/yr. PO number will be created once DPA + order form ready.

Ben (SE): Practically, for the KMS clause we should add: 

```
- Customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM integration
- Redwood will not export plaintext keys
- Operational access limited and logged; audit logs retained 1 year
```

Ben (SE): Jordan — is that enough language or do you want stronger indemnities?

Jordan (Legal): That's a good start. I'll add precise wording referencing our KMS appendix and remove any ambiguous "no export" phrasing. Also need to check their redline that limits liability under SLA — might be risky.

Maya (AE): They specifically asked for SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime and 2 hour incident response for sev1.

Jordan (Legal): 99.9% is fine to discuss for Dedicated, but 2 hour response is tight. We can offer 2 hour on-call notification + 4 hour mitigation SLA in the order form. Need approval from SRE for response commitment.

Ben (SE): @kms-bot confirm: HSM integration supports AWS KMS, GCP external KMS, and on-prem PKCS#11?

kms-bot: HSM capabilities: AWS KMS (yes), GCP external KMS (yes), Azure Key Vault (partial), PKCS#11 HSM (supported via gateway). Documentation: https://docs.redwood/supported-kms

Carlos (Finance): If they're committing 12 months @ $45k, invoice cadence? Annual in advance preferred. Procurement asked for net30 invoice with PO — can we do annual invoiced upfront but with net30 terms?

Jordan (Legal): Legal is fine with annual in advance Billing with net30 payment terms on the invoice. We'll document billing schedule in order form.

Maya (AE): Request: Jordan, can you produce a clean DPA + order form template with the KMS appendix and the modified SLA language by EOD? Procurement needs to route to legal and then sign.

Jordan (Legal): I'll prepare a redline and a clean DPA + order form. ETA EOD PST. I'll include a short summary of the major changes for procurement to review.

Ksenia (PS): On the technical side, I'll attach the deployment checklist for Dedicated (network, peering, certs) so their infra team can start prelim work. Link: https://playbooks.redwood/dedicated-deploy-checklist

Maya (AE): Great. Also: do we want to offer countersign or DocuSign? Procurement prefers DocuSign.

Carlos (Finance): DocuSign is fine. For accounting, please cc billing@redwood when they send the signed order + PO. We need PO number to match invoice.

Maya (AE): Noted. I'll ask Acme to confirm billing entity and send PO number once DPA+order form ready.

Ben (SE): One more technical ask from Acme: can we add a clause about model pinning for production traffic? They want a version guarantee for the first 3 months.

Jordan (Legal): Add a short clause: "Customer may pin a Major.Minor model version for initial 90 days; Redwood will not change pinned model without 30 days notice." I'll add that.

Maya (AE): Summary / action items: 
- Jordan: DPA + order form + KMS appendix + model-pinning clause by EOD (threaded deliverable)
- Ksenia/Ben: deployment checklist + confirm HSM specifics to share with Acme infra
- Carlos: confirm billing entity + invoice cadence and confirm annual-in-advance language is okay for AR
- Maya: confirm with Acme procurement DocuSign path and PO timing

Carlos (Finance): I'll follow up with AR after Jordan's clean doc. If all good, billing will accept DocuSign + PO and issue invoice net30.

Maya (AE): Thanks team :pray: I'll ping again when Acme confirms.

Jordan (Legal): Uploaded clean bundles here when ready. Will post link in thread.

kms-bot: Reminder: include KMS appendix ID: APP-KMS-2026-v1 when attaching

Maya (AE): Perfect — closing loop, will update thread when I hear from procurement. :white_check_mark:
